subject: 📑 Disciplinary Notice — Case $case_reference
body:
Dear $student_name,

This letter formally notifies you of a disciplinary matter that has been raised against you. Please read it carefully and take the action requested by the deadline below.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
CASE DETAILS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Student ID:         $student_id
Case Reference:     $case_reference
Date of Incident:   $incident_date
Reported By:        $reported_by
Letter Issued On:   $letter_date
Decision Maker:     $decision_maker
Matter Stage:       $matter_stage

ALLEGATION
────────────────────────────────────────────────────
$allegation
────────────────────────────────────────────────────

FINDINGS / RULING
────────────────────────────────────────────────────
$findings
────────────────────────────────────────────────────

SANCTIONS / NEXT STEPS
────────────────────────────────────────────────────
$sanctions
────────────────────────────────────────────────────

YOUR RIGHTS

  • You may be accompanied by a Students' Union representative or a friend at any meeting.
  • You may request copies of any evidence relied on in this case.
  • You may submit a written response to the points above by $response_by.
  • You may appeal the outcome within 10 working days, following the Appeals Procedure.

Failure to respond by the deadline will not stop the process; a decision will be taken on the information available.

If this letter raises welfare concerns for you, please contact Student Support — separate from the disciplinary process — for confidential help.

Yours sincerely,
$decision_maker
Office of Student Conduct
